case.must_observe.1.rationale: Explicitly links REF-21 section 3 advisory outcome to verified-payee control objective, stated significant fraudulent-account-change risk, C-21A independent callback and scope-dependent keyness. Preserves the need to validate release reliance, contact governance and other controls.

case.must_observe.2.rationale: Distinguishes A key candidate, B reporting/presentation support and C proposed alternative. It correctly refuses to assume B is a risk-mitigating supporting control without criteria/reliance, and allows a separate data-quality supporting-control assessment if established. Explains A removal exposure, why B cannot compensate and what C must demonstrate for equivalent coverage.

case.must_observe.3.rationale: States designations are analyst proposals awaiting organization review/approval; fictional REF-21 remains advisory, not a real standard, adopted obligation or compliance conclusion.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: Does not label all activities key or approved. A is only a candidate; B is not key for the significant risk; C remains untested Target-State and is not counted as current protection.

case.must_not_observe.2.rationale: Does not reject C for having a different name/technology. Evaluates potential equivalence through coverage, precision, timing, independence, common-mode failure, exceptions, evidence and authorized transition.
